actions.description: ONE TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD: both hands together on its long hilt, draw sword behind shoulder, torso twist, powerful horizontal sweep right, recover two-handed grip
ONE TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD: low two-hand grip, rotate torso back, heavy turning sweep with BOTH hands on hilt, settle
ONE TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD: ready low, both arms lift same sword overhead, powerful downward chop, lift blade back with both hands
ONE TWO-HANDED GREATSWORD: ready, lift blade diagonally in front, brace with BOTH hands on same hilt, lower
Original crossbow: low ready, raise and brace, release bolt facing right with empty rail, lower to reload
Crossbow: crouch, aim skyward, fire upward, lower bow
Crossbow: aim right, shift weight backward, backward hop while firing, land
Crossbow: low ready, knees bend, lean forward to sprint, recover
Open spellbook: read, free hand gathers at chest, forceful forward palm release, hand returns
Open book: lower stance, free hand raises, sweeps free palm down toward ground, stands
Book held to side: hand at chest, raise arm, point overhead, lower
Open book: reach forward, fingers curl, draw elbow back to pull, return
Straight punch: guard, draw rear fist back, punch straight right, return guard
Uppercut: guard, deep crouch fist low, upward punch extending legs, recover
Front kick: guard, raise bent knee, extend kicking leg right, set foot down
Parry: guard, cross forearms, brace and deflect outward, restore guard
Single dagger: ready, reverse-grip windup, low rightward slash, retract
Dagger held aside: crouch, hand reaches belt, free hand places a small trap at ground, rise
Dagger: low stance, compressed crouch, forward lunge, low recovery
Dagger finisher: ready, raises dagger, decisive downward stab toward empty ground, withdraw
Original sword AND shield: ready, shield lifts, firmly brace behind shield, lower slightly
Shield bash: shield near chest, weight on rear foot, thrust shield forward with front step, recover
Sword cut behind shield: ready, sword cocked back, sword cuts right while shield guards, recover
Shield rush: shield ready, crouch, shield-first forward lean, stable stop
Original single sword: ready, sword back, horizontal cut, return
Single sword: low stance, quarter turn back, broad turning cut right, settle
Single sword: crouch, sword overhead, downward two-handed slash, recover
Single sword: ready, blade across torso, firm diagonal parry, reset
Rune sword: ready, back swing, rightward slash, reset
Sword in one hand: free hand at chest, palm beside blade, free palm pushes forward, retract
Sword: ready, blade raises, touches tip to ground in front while crouching, rise
Sword: ready, crouch, rapid forward thrust posture, recover
Open book: read, free arm raises, free palm directs toward ground, return
Pet command: read, elbow bends, decisive pointing gesture forward, retract
Book to side: free hand at chest, opens palm, lifts open palm gently, return
Book: holds low, raises open book before chest, free palm presses forward defensively, lower
Original ornate staff: ready, pulls staff back, points staff straight forward, retract
Staff: ready, lifts staff slightly, plants staff butt on ground with bent knees, rise
Staff: ready, raises staff, holds staff fully overhead, lowers
Staff held beside body: free hand curls inward, windup, free arm points forward firmly, retract
Original sun staff: ready, free hand over heart, lifts staff and opens free palm upward, return
Sun staff: ready, brace staff near chest, free palm presses forward, relax
Cleanse: ready, staff tips outward, free hand sweeps out gently, return
Blessing: staff low, raise staff, hold staff overhead with upright posture, lower
Original longbow: nock arrow, full draw to cheek, release string with empty bow, lower
Longbow: nock, draw aiming high, skyward release with empty bow, lower
Charged aim: low stance, deepest full bow draw, powerful release, recover
Retreat shot: draw right, shift backward, backward step while releasing, regain stance
Trap placement: crossbow to side, crouch with original small trap, set trap on ground, rise
Crossbow: ready, shoulder and aim, fire right with empty rail, lower
Pet command: bow lowered, free hand near mouth as whistle, points forward, relax
Crossbow: ready, crouch, forward alert running lean, stop
Original whip: coiled ready, short overhead loop windup, whip snaps right fully inside cell, recoil
Grappling rope: ready, raise hook, throw hook to right with SHORT rope within cell, retract
Rope pull: reaches with rope, braces feet, pulls both hands to torso, settle
Rope coiled at belt: crouch, preload, forward leap, landing
Original scythe: ready, scythe back, sweeps low right, returns
Scythe: crouch, torso turns, turning horizontal sweep, settle
Scythe held upright: chain hand cocks back, braces, throws SHORT chain right within cell, retract
Scythe: low stance, compress, forward dash lean, stable recovery
Cards: hold deck, pull one card to shoulder, flick card hand forward without detached projectile, return
Fan: hold deck, spread cards in hand, fan-shaped throwing gesture without detached cards, recover
Dice: holds original die in palm, hand lowers, upward toss gesture without airborne die, returns
Deck in hand: ready, crouch, quick sidestep lean, recover
Wrapped fists: guard, rear fist back, straight punch, guard
Hook: guard, torso rotates back, bent-arm hook right, recover
Uppercut: guard, fist dips low, upward fist strike, recover
Weave: guard, dips left, forward low shoulder weave, guard
Charge palm: ready, deep low stance palm drawn back, heavy forward palm thrust, recover
Ground slam: crouch, fist raised, fist strikes empty ground, rise
Heavy kick: guard, knee tucked high, long side kick right, foot lowers
Parry: guard, forearms cross, braces low against impact, restores guard
Front kick: guard, knee chamber, extend front kick right, return
Roundhouse: guard, pivot support foot and chamber knee, arcing horizontal kick right, return
Knee strike: guard, lean back and chamber, drive knee forward, return
Meditation: guard, hands join at chest, calm standing palms open upward, return
